name: Shin-Etsu Polymer India pvt ltd
capabilities: Front Opening Unified Pods (FOUP) for 300mm wafers
summary: Shin-Etsu Polymer India Pvt Ltd provides materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing, specifically focusing on wafer handling and transport solutions such as FOUPs and wafer shipping boxes for 300mm wafers. These products are crucial for maintaining wafer integrity and cleanliness during transport and automation processes.
